chunks: In the midst of gardens and of springs,

key_terms.جَنَّاتٍ: Gardens (plural of Jannah, referring to Paradise)
key_terms.عُيُونٍ: Springs (plural of Ayn, referring to flowing water sources)

ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of Paradise described in Surah Ad-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan is often interpreted as a reward for those who endured the trials of the Day of Judgment with patience, linking physical bliss to spiritual purification. The 'springs' (uyun) are seen not merely as water sources but as metaphors for the flowing knowledge and divine grace bestowed upon the righteous, reflecting the Imams' teachings on the continuity of divine guidance.
